name: Skinned model deform gate
about: Run: gaw gate --spec skills/gaw/references/deform-gate.json --out-dir NEW_DIR CANDIDATE.glb (from the Modding folder). Runs gaw deform-check once (clips, stretch, squash, volume, intersect, weights) against stock and judges each kind relative to what stock itself shows. No defects run.

rules.why: triangles pulled past the edge limit in some clip frame
triangles crushed past the edge limit
candy-wrapper twists and joints that lose volume
arm through torso and other new pass-throughs
vertices with no weight, bad sums or too many influences
